title: 2026 Week 6 all units, PO/PD 45-45-10, RO six-metric, RD prior model, SEC-first conference
method: PO = 45% passing PPA + 45% passing success + 10% passing explosiveness national percentiles, plus opponent pass-defense bonus and conference adjustment. PD = 45% low allowed passing PPA + 45% low allowed passing success + 10% low allowed passing explosiveness national percentiles, plus opponent passing offense quality bonus and identical conference adjustment. RO retains six equally weighted rushing performance metrics. RD retains existing rushing-specific research rating with updated conference adjustment. Offensive and Defensive Strength each average their two units. Overall is sensitivity-updated from the previous research model, not completely rebuilt.
limitations: Defensive unit metrics not reconstructed or independently recalibrated; only conference delta applied.
PO and RO research percentages and PD/RD older scale may not be directly comparable; provisional composite until unit scales validated.
Defensive passing metrics use lower-is-better allowed values; no custom override for any team.
PD percentile plus prior scale RD is provisional and has not been calibrated for direct scale parity.
Opponent-quality bonuses reward facing a top-30 unit rather than measuring game-specific outperformance.
